name: Samurai Standing
purpose: Active hero portrait on dashboard and profile screens.
visual: Poised confident stance with sheathed katana at waist under blazing red sun.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration for a premium video game, inspired by bold cinematic silhouette poster art. An honorable samurai standing in a confident poised stance with sheathed katana at side, pure pitch-black silhouette with sharp crimson armor laces. Huge solid crimson-red sun disc backdrop, clean graphic shapes, high contrast, no anime, no 3D, no text.
